nodes.name: acceptance.md
nodes.summary: Acceptance criteria for Document feature: 7 ACs covering auto-generation on workflow completion, HTML storage, PDF generation, viewing, searching, downloading, and document settings. Each AC maps to REQ and US identifiers.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown specification file with Given/When/Then BDD-style acceptance criteria.

nodes.name: api.md
nodes.summary: API specification for Document feature: GET /api/documents (list with pagination/search/filter), GET /api/documents/:id (detail), GET /api/documents/:id/pdf (download), GET/PUT /api/documents/settings. Includes error response codes.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown specification file defining REST API endpoints with JSON request/response schemas.

nodes.name: business-rules.md
nodes.summary: Business rules for Document: 3 validation rules (required fields), 4 permission rules (role-based access), 2 state transition rules (Generating→Generated/Failed), 3 business constraints (immutability, linkage, PDF fidelity), and 2 side effects.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown specification file with tabular business rule definitions.

nodes.name: domain.md
nodes.summary: Domain model for Document feature: Document entity (10 attributes, state machine Generating→Generated/Failed), DocumentVersion entity (6 attributes), DocumentSettings entity (8 attributes). Defines N:1 relationships to Instance, Administration, Template and 1:N to DocumentVersion.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown specification file defining domain entities, attributes, relationships, and invariants.

nodes.name: requirements.md
nodes.summary: Requirements specification for Document: 5 user stories (generate, view, search, download, settings), 8 functional requirements (REQ-DC-001..008), 4 non-functional requirements (NFR-DC-001..004), constraints, edge cases, and dependencies on Administration/Template/Render Engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown specification file with structured requirements, user stories, and priority classifications.

nodes.name: tasks.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for Document feature: 12 sequential tasks from database schema (TASK-001) through shared types, repository, service, PDF generation, API routes, composable, UI (list/viewer/settings), tests, to final verification. Each task lists affected files, dependencies, and verification criteria.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown specification file defining ordered implementation tasks with dependencies and file targets.

nodes.name: test-cases.md
nodes.summary: Test cases for Document: 3 unit tests (DocumentService generation/storage/PDF), 1 integration test (full lifecycle), 5 API tests (all endpoints), 2 E2E tests (view/download), and 3 edge cases (complex layout, 100+ pages, PDF failure).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown specification file with tabular test case definitions across multiple test levels.

nodes.name: ui.md
nodes.summary: UI specification for Document: 3 pages (/documents, /documents/:id, /documents/settings) with wireframe layouts. Documents list with search/filters, Document viewer with HTML rendering and metadata, Settings page for page size/margins/headers/footers. Includes responsive breakpoints and loading/empty/error states.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown specification file with ASCII wireframe layouts and responsive behavior tables.

nodes.name: ux.md
nodes.summary: UX specification for Document: 3 user flows (view document, download PDF, generate document) with step-by-step diagrams. Feedback table (loading/toast/error), keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+P print, Cmd+S download, Escape close).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown specification file defining user interaction flows and feedback mechanisms.
